author: Second Wind
description:
This week has been home to the Summer Games Done Quick speedrunning charity event. Marty’s latest essay digs into why in an era of massive layoffs, studio closures, game cancellations, and anti-consumer sentiment, GDQ remains one of the unequivocally good things in an otherwise bleak industry.

Watch GDQ on YouTube --https://www.youtube.com/@UCI3DTtB-a3fJPjKtQ5kYHfA 

Watch GDQ on Twitch -- https://www.twitch.tv/gamesdonequick

If you dig these kinds of video essays, consider supporting us over at Patreon -- https://www.patreon.com/SecondWindGroup

Check out a whole mess of Second Wind merch over at our store -- https://shop.secondwindgroup.com/
title: Stop Watching This and Go Watch Games Done Quick
